ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low; surface area is approximately 92% low-intensity (black) with high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels isolated to localized scarring, punctate spots, and distal tip encrustations.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: vertical high-intensity linear streaks concentrated in the central region. Right lobe: high-intensity circular punctates distributed across the mid-to-lower surface. Distal tips: high-intensity, high-texture clusters localized at the furthest lateral points of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 45-50 degrees; depth extends approximately 25% into the vertical height of the visible fluke structure.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Medium-frequency serrations with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 4 to 12 pixels; serrations are most pronounced on the inner trailing edges adjacent to the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trailing edge trajectory sweeping upward and outward toward the distal tips; leading edge exhibits a primary upward curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast, multi-pixel textured clusters (consistent with barnacle colonization) located exclusively on the distal tips of both lobes; several discrete 5-10 pixel diameter white circular spots on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: High-contrast linear pixel disruptions on the left lobe, including four primary vertical rake marks and two intersecting horizontal-diagonal marks; right lobe shows fewer, shorter horizontal disruptions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on the distal tips of both lobes; prominent multi-directional rake marks on the left ventral surface; irregular serrations on the trailing edge of the right lobe.
